forecast.desc_ok: On the known history it did better than a naive forecast (repeating the last value): it is shown in the Trend.
forecast.desc_unreliable: On the known history it did not do better than a naive forecast: it is not shown.
forecast.desc_learning: More history is needed before this tag can be forecast.
forecast.desc_disabled: Forecasts are off for this tag or a level above it (gateway, area, site, organization).
forecast.desc_pending: Not computed yet: it will be within a few minutes.
forecast.inherit_hint: A field on “Inherit” takes its value from the gateway, area, site or organization.
forecast.page_subtitle: Where the plant's tags are going, with the uncertainty band and how far it can be trusted.
forecast.no_model: The Timestral model is not configured on this server: forecasts use the statistical engine.
forecast.empty: No tag to forecast. Forecasts cover numeric or digital tags with history on.
forecast.settings_intro: Set forecasts for the whole organization or for a site, an area, a gateway: the levels below inherit unless they say otherwise. A single tag is set from its own tab.
forecast.readonly: Only administrators can change the settings.
forecast.select_org: Select an organization to see its forecasts.
forecast.risks_none: No alarm limit at risk within the horizon.
forecast.anomaly_none_one: The latest value stayed within the forecast.
forecast.anomaly_none_other: The latest {{count}} values stayed within the forecast.
forecast.machines_intro: A machine groups the tags of one plant or device. Its health (0–100) is that of its worst part: limits at risk and values off the forecast. With a state tag (running/stopped) the forecasts learn from running time only.
forecast.machines_empty: No machines. Make one per gateway with “Create from gateways”, or compose your own.
forecast.health_hint: 100 minus the worst problem among its tags. “Unknown” while no tag has a reliable forecast yet.
forecast.machine_unknown: No tag with a reliable forecast yet.
forecast.machine_state_hint: Its tags' forecasts use only the time “{{alias}}” says the machine runs.
forecast.machine_delete_q: Delete the machine “{{name}}”? Its tags stay.
forecast.machine_form_hint: Pick the tags that belong to this machine and, if there is one, the digital tag that says when it runs.
forecast.period_extrapolated_hint: The period ends past the forecast's horizon: the rest follows the forecast rate.
forecast.oee_intro: Where each profile's OEE will be at the end of the shift (or of the day, with no shift on): running hours and pieces from its tags' forecasts, with the OEE page's formula.
forecast.oee_no_pieces: Needs a reliable forecast on the profile's pieces counter (and a pieces-per-hour target).
forecast.totals_intro: Counters (energy, volumes, pieces) and states: how much they will have counted by the end of the shift, the day and the month. What has passed is measured, the rest is forecast with its band.
forecast.totals_empty: No counter or state with a reliable forecast yet.
forecast.setup_intro: What forecasts already have to work with and what is worth setting up, with a link to do it.
forecast.setup_tags_none: No numeric or digital tag with history on: forecasts learn from history. Turn it on for the tags to forecast.
forecast.setup_tags_learning: {{count}} tags learning: each needs at least 24 values before its first forecast.
forecast.setup_tags_ok: {{ok}} of {{total}} tags already have a reliable forecast; {{learning}} are still learning.
forecast.setup_model_on: On, on the server: forecasts also use the model, where it does better.
forecast.setup_model_off: The statistical engine is always on and enough to start. Timestral (more accurate on cycles and machines) is turned on on the server: make forecast-up, or the forecast profile on Coolify.
forecast.setup_machines_none: Group the tags of each piece of equipment: you get a health score. To start, one machine per gateway.
forecast.setup_state_detail: {{count}} of {{total}} machines have a running tag: their forecasts learn from running time only. Only needed for machines that stop.
forecast.setup_shifts_ok: {{list}}. Used for end-of-shift totals and OEE.
forecast.setup_shifts_none: Without shifts, totals and OEE are worked out to the end of the day and month, not the shift.
forecast.setup_maintenance_ok_one: {{count}} window planned: the model knows the plant is still then.
forecast.setup_maintenance_ok_other: {{count}} windows planned: the model knows the plant is still then.
forecast.setup_maintenance_none: None planned. Entering them keeps the model from mistaking a planned stop for a fault.
forecast.setup_oee_none: No OEE profile: only needed where pieces are counted, for the OEE expected at the end of the shift.
forecast.setup_oee_detail: {{ready}} of {{total}} profiles have an OEE forecast: it needs a reliable forecast on the pieces counter and a pieces-per-hour target.
forecast.setup_levels_default: Defaults for the whole organization: 24 hours ahead, 28 days of history. Change them below for a site, an area or a gateway.
forecast.setup_levels_custom_one: {{count}} level has its own settings (marked with a dot below); the others inherit.
forecast.setup_levels_custom_other: {{count}} levels have their own settings (marked with a dot below); the others inherit.
